phases.objective: Provide an exact issue-comment-gated, checksum-bound runtime-readiness path for Spec 014 Wave 1 that verifies Production parity, performs readback first, creates only the governed authorization control-plane evidence when needed, and executes dry_run with applies_sql=false.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized repository operator and governed Spec 014 Wave 1 readiness workflow
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR comment on control issue #6215
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow proves the current protected Production SHA and exact migration blob, performs schema and ledger readback before mutation, creates or reuses only checksum-bound authorization control-plane evidence, completes a governed dry-run with applies_sql=false, and never authorizes or executes Apply.
steps: Require the exact filename-derived authorization comment on issue #6215 from an allowed repository association.
Checkout trusted main and prove it contains readiness merge 0f83d8faf1abf8b0bf149f08c10f652d2a3ed3fa.
Read the protected Production ref and prove it contains source merge 7a96920eff2579321707d193a1d030e6454891b1.
Verify Production contains migration blob 1e820553d95e5bdb5f8c49d7bf09cb159c51c7bc and runtime health, version, and deployment evidence converge on the same protected SHA.
Perform governed schema and ledger readback before creating any new authorization evidence.
If the exact apply ledger already exists, report already_applied without creating authorization or dry-run evidence.
Otherwise create and approve only a checksum- and Production-bound capability envelope for governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap.
Bootstrap the exact authorization for checksum 9eca6e585d12de633931c7d7e099f467a955aaf7b819ccb2660d34acf63d5053, four statements, PR #4564, and its merge SHA.
Execute governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode and require applies_sql=false, exact checksum and statement count, preflight pass, and zero risk.
Upload sanitized evidence without repository writes, provider calls, credential payload reads, business-data mutation, Apply authorization, Apply execution, deployment, or Production mutation.
assertions: The workflow requires issue #6215, the exact authorization comment, and OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association.
The workflow never exposes an Apply job and has no push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, or automatic runtime trigger.
Readback occurs before capability-envelope or authorization creation.
The implementation contains no mode=apply request and no capability_resolution_envelope_apply_authorize call.
The dry-run must report mode=dry_run, applies_sql=false, exact checksum, four statements, preflight pass, and zero risks.
Managed control-plane authorization evidence may be written only after the explicit operator comment; migration SQL, business data, providers, external systems, and Production refs remain unmodified.

Artifacts report apply_authorized=false, apply_sent=false, migration_apply_executed=false, provider_call_executed=false, credential_payload_accessed=false, external_business_write_executed=false, and secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: After merge, post the exact authorized comment and retain the runtime parity, readback, authorization-bootstrap, dry-run, and no-secret Artifact evidence.
Keep Production drift, migration blob drift, runtime parity failure, existing-ledger ambiguity, checksum rotation, and dry-run risk fail-closed with bounded evidence.
Use a successful runtime-readiness Artifact only as a prerequisite for a separately reviewed Wave 1 Apply contract.
This contract grants no Migration Apply, deployment, provider call, external business write, credential payload read, or Production ref mutation authority.
